description.value:
Cast 1 minute

Range 1 mile, for the relay

Duration permanent

Scavenger-flavored, open to all — a tiny drone scout you can send ahead.

You build a scrap ghost: a Tiny construct with your Perception, a fly Speed of 25 feet, and 1 Hit Point per your level. It has no attacks and cannot carry anything heavier than a key. You can send it ahead and see and hear through its sensors at up to a mile. If it is destroyed you can rebuild it over an hour from scrap.

cinderfall.incomplete: The GrantItem call (Pattern Reference C, matching pf2e's own familiar-witch.json:27-30) spawns a real familiar actor tied to the PC -- that half is proposed as real system.rules. The card's specific customizations (Perception matching the caster's own, fly Speed exactly 25 ft, HP exactly 1/level, no attacks at all, and a 1-mile remote-sensing relay) are, in real pf2e, set by picking individual familiar-ability compendium items directly onto the familiar's own actor sheet after creation -- not encoded via system.rules on the granting card. Building those out needs new/matching familiar-ability records per making-standard/Making-Familiars.md; see Open Questions #4 in .claude/scratch/feats-class-scrapwright-draft.md.
